await nav('items');await p.locator('#itemBody [data-drawing="RFQ-L00001"]').click();await p.waitForTimeout(15000);await shot('PDF-real-preview-after-restart');await p.keyboard.press('Escape');await check('PDF closes normally',await p.locator('#drawingModal').getAttribute('aria-hidden'),'true');if(!await p.locator('#itemIntake').isVisible())await p.locator('#toggleItemIntake').click();await p.locator('#importFile').setInputFiles('/tmp/r10/fixtures/invalid.xlsx');await p.waitForTimeout(4200);await shot('invalid-import');await check('invalid preview does not autosave business',fp('17-invalid-preview'),final);await p.locator('#clearPastePreview').click();await p.waitForTimeout(4200);await check('cancel preview does not change RFQ identities',fp('18-preview-cancelled'),final);await nav('quoteImport');await p.locator('#quoteImportSupplier').selectOption('U24-A');await p.locator('#confirmQuoteRound').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();await p.locator('#confirmQuoteRound').hover();await shot('P3-after-restart');await check('lock hint remains visible after actual restart',await p.locator('#srmV3QuoteLockHint').isVisible(),true);await tell('loaded V31 runtime',await p.evaluate(()=>({background:getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor,styles:[...document.querySelectorAll('style')].map(e=>({id:e.id,rules:e.sheet.cssRules.length})),externalScripts:[...document.scripts].filter(e=>e.src).map(e=>e.src),pageStageTitles:[...document.querySelectorAll('.srm-v3-pageIntro h2')].map(e=>e.innerText)})));await check('final business fingerprint unchanged',fp('19-final'),final);await p.close();await c.tracing.stop({path:root+'independent-v31-browser-trace.zip'});await b.close();console.log('V31_BUSINESS_AND_PARITY_CAPTURE_COMPLETE');
